title: Watch: Moment opposition MP throws eggs at Kosovo's acting PM
summary_full: Lawmakers and police officers had to intervene after Alliance party MP Time Kadrijaj hurled at least four eggs towards Kosovo's acting prime minister Albin Kurti.
